move: dark cards fade up quietly, border sheen travels, rows check off
how: On a near-black stage with a soft indigo glow, the headline blurs in (filter blur 8px to 0, y 18, power3.out 0.9s), a subline follows, a hairline scales open (expo.out 1.2s) and three bordered cards rise 28px into place (power3.out 1s, 120ms stagger) from 6% of the 8s loop; icon, heading, paragraph and mock task rows lift in with small staggers. At 27% a masked gradient border sheen (a ::before pseudo element driven by CSS variable --sx from -100% to 100%, power2.inOut 1.2s) travels each card in turn, 0.5s apart. Task checkboxes fill at 45% and 52%, the command-menu rows highlight one after another (background yoyo at 60%), and the glow breathes over the whole loop. At 89% the cards lift 20px and fade (power2.in, 80ms stagger) with the header and line following.
adapt: Replace the headline, subline, three card titles/copy and the mock task rows; recolour the indigo accent (#5e6ad2) and glow. Keep the restrained 1s power3.out rises and the 0.5s sheen cadence.
port: mount(el, shot) builds glow, header, line and cards inside el, including the ::before sheen styles. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline; the sheen tweens CSS custom properties (--sx, --so) on each card, which GSAP supports, and the nth-child selectors must be scoped to el.
caveats: animates filter: blur on the headline
sheen relies on a ::before with mask-composite and CSS variables set via GSAP
ends on an empty stage, not the first frame
